# maas-nightly-qe-impact

Assess whether a Models-as-a-Service autofix change requires follow-up in opendatahub-tests or ods-ci nightly QE pipelines. Runs as a Jira autofix post_review extension for the Model as a Service component. Appends a Nightly QE Impact section to the PR description and writes informational findings. Use when autofix completes a fix in models-as-a-service.

**Plugin**: [odh-maas](index.md) | **:material-check: User-invocable**

## Usage

```bash
/maas-nightly-qe-impact
```
